thread:
Mina: Quick thread to lock scope for the 'Optimize Recommendations' roadmap item. Goal: pilot a recommendations-only advisor that suggests batching, prefix caching, and conservative quant profiles, plus eval-triggered alerts. Need owners, acceptance gates, and privacy constraints. Short takes?

Owen: Love it. MVP should be read-only recommendations + a request-apply flow for dedicated customers that opens an ops ticket. No auto-apply or autopilot in alpha.

Priya: Acceptance gates I care about: 1) recommendation safety: expected quality delta <=1.5% on core prompt suites; 2) concordance >=87% with SME decisions on curated prompts; 3) p50 latency impact when applied <=6%; 4) alert false-positive rate <12% over a 14d window.

Caleb: Runtime guardrails: batching heuristics should never increase p95 by >12% and must respect per-request token thresholds (don't batch tiny requests). Prefix cache recs should include estimated reuse rate and cold-start penalty. Quant recs are 'suggest only' and must require tenant shadowing before apply for private installs.

Nora: Privacy checklist: telemetry_consent is mandatory for any exported examples. Two toggles in Console: (1) recommendation opt-in, (2) export/triage opt-in. Export features disabled by default and blocked for dedicated until legal signs off.

Mina: UX expectations: Console card shows savings estimate (USD/month), confidence band, expected p50 latency delta, short rationale, and a "request apply" button for dedicated accounts. API returns a recommendations array and a minimal explainability snippet.

Owen: Example API snippet we discussed (minimal fields):

```json
{
  "route": "/v1/chat",
  "recs": [
    {"type":"batching","suggested_batch":6,"expected_tokens_saved_pct":10.2,"confidence":0.8},
    {"type":"kv_cache","prefix_len":64,"estimated_reuse_pct":18.5,"confidence":0.72},
    {"type":"quant","profile":"int8-safe","expected_quality_delta_pct":1.2,"confidence":0.65}
  ],
  "meta": {"model":"redwood-4b","generated_at":"2026-03-23T09:12:00Z"}
}
```

Priya: Note: meta must never contain raw prompts or customer PII. If telemetry_consent==false, strip examples and sample traces from payloads.

Caleb: Canary plan for pilot: 1) apply to 2% traffic for 12h, monitor p50/p95 and eval hooks, 2) expand to 10% for 24h if stable, 3) manual approve for broader rollout. Dedicated customers always require ops ticket before any traffic change.

Nora: Alert config example for eval-triggered alerting (ops review):

```yaml
alert:
  id: "optimize.eval.regression"
  metric: "quality.delta"
  window: "7d"
  threshold_pct: 2.0
  min_samples: 150
  notify: ["sre","product","cs"]
  attach_triage_bundle_if: "telemetry_consent"
```

Mina: Launch checklist (alpha -> pilot): 1) two pilot customers (one hosted, one dedicated), 2) Console opt-in toggles + quickstart, 3) E2E tests for batching/cache/quant paths, 4) eval harness + curated prompt suites, 5) runbook + rollback steps, 6) privacy sign-off for any export.

Owen: Owners: Owen -> runtime heuristics & canary; Priya -> eval harness, thresholds, and alerting; Caleb -> privacy & ops ticketing integration; Nora -> Console UI & explainability text; Mina -> PM + pilot coordination. Target alpha in 3 weeks.

Priya: Immediate risks: 1) sampling mismatch between our evals and customer traffic, 2) over-confident recommendations on low-sample routes, 3) export/legal delays. Mitigations: conservative confidence thresholds, require shadowing for quant recs, and block exports until legal clears.

ops-bot: deploy queued: optimize-recs/alpha -> staging at 3612340025 by @ci-bot

Caleb: CS ask: please add an exportable triage bundle for alerts (examples + model context + timestamps) but gate it on telemetry_consent toggles and legal approval. I'll coordinate with GammaCorp legal.

Mina: Perfect. I'll synthesize this into a short spec and share with the pilot candidates today. Post any blockers here. :rocket:
